They contain no changed lines, because the changed ranges (head 1087-1090, 1101-1148, 2030-2047) fall outside the supplied text. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could see only the scheduler-configuration table changes. These document Gemma 4 prefillChunkSize 2048 and step budget 4096. They also document a new bidirectionalMediaPrefillChunkCeiling of 512 and changes to the solo prefill stripe for Gemma 4 and dense Qwen. These are performance and geometry documentation updates in EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift. No code is shown, and no authorization, attestation, encryption, key custody, billing or cache-scope behavior is changed in the visible evidence.

This matches T-041 and does not conflict with it. A wider prefill chunk could affect memory admission and availability (T-029, T-010). That would depend on source changes I cannot see, since the code is not supplied. The head ranges 1101-1148 and 2030-2047 are not visible, so I cannot confirm that the documentation does not loosen prefix-cache TTL, disk-budget or scope semantics. The next pass should check that the unseen head hunks do not state policy changes that need a fresh SEC-035 sign-off. It should also check that the corresponding Swift source changes (prefillGeometry, wide prefill chunk for Gemma 4) keep per-request memory admission intact. No concrete regression is identifiable from the supplied evidence.
